properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 1:48PM EDT until July 31 at 2:45PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
SMWJAX

The National Weather Service in Jacksonville has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM...

* Until 245 PM EDT.

* At 148 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Marineland,
or 8 nm north of Palm Coast, moving east at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Beverly Beach, Big Georges Reef, Marineland, Crescent Beach, and
Palm Coast.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes. If your vessel is
caught offshore, immediately secure for heavy weather. Ensure all
crew members are wearing USCG approved Type I life jackets and
nonessential crew are below decks. Deploy jack lines and harnesses if
available. Check life saving equipment, including batteries on
handheld radios, for readiness.
properties.area: Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 1:46PM EDT until July 31 at 3:15PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm...

At 145 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 7 nm northeast of Ormond-By-the-Sea to near Daytona
Beach Shores to near Edgewater, moving east at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

Locations impacted include...
New Smyrna Beach Airport, Ponce Inlet, Edgewater, New Smyrna Beach,
and Wilbur By The Sea.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent cloud to water lightning is occurring with these storms. If
caught on the open water stay below deck and, if possible, avoid
ungrounded metal objects. Remember, lightning can strike beyond 10
miles away from a thunderstorm.
properties.area: Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm

properties.description:
At 1209 PM CDT...Fair weather waterspouts were located near Middle
Bay Light...moving east at 5 knots.

Locations impacted include...
East Fowl River Bridge, Alabama Port, and Middle Bay Light.

The primary threats from these waterspouts are wind gusts up to 30
knots and locally higher waves. Boaters should consider seeking safe
harbor until these waterspouts have passed.

Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
waves and seas. If a waterspout is sighted...seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.title: Air Quality Alert issued July 31 at 9:32AM PDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
AQAMSO

* WHAT...Air Quality Advisory due to smoke from wildfires.

Air Quality Index ranging from Moderate to Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups.

* WHERE...All Areas on the Nez Perce Reservation.

* WHEN...Until 10:00 AM PDT Monday August 3.

* IMPACTS...Those who experience health effects from smoke include
children under 18, elders, pregnant women, people with asthma
or have difficulty breathing, diabetes, heart problems or
otherwise compromised health, and people who have high exposure
(those who work, exercise, or spend extensive time outdoors).
properties.instruction:
Under the most severe pollution level, sensitive groups should avoid
outdoor exposure and limit indoor activities, and everyone should
restrict their outdoor activities.

Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
https://healthandwelfare.idaho.gov/health-wellness/environmental-
health/wildfire-smoke
Idaho Smoke Information Hotline: 1-800-345-1007

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued July 31 at 9:57AM CDT until July 31 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS St Louis MO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Saint Clair County in southwestern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 100 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Overflowing poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 957 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Belleville, O'Fallon, East St. Louis, Collinsville, Fairview
Heights, Cahokia, Swansea, Shiloh, Centreville, Freeburg,
Caseyville, Washington Park, Dupo, Millstadt, Madison, Cahokia
Parks Airport, Smithton and Fairmont City.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 31 at 9:10AM CDT until August 1 at 2:00PM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in South Dakota...

Little Minnesota River near Peever affecting Roberts County.

.For sites with a river forecast, the forecast includes precipitation
through the next 24 hours. Any future precipitation could affect the
forecasts.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Little Minnesota River near Peever.

* WHEN...Until Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Left bank below gage begins flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 AM CDT Friday the stage was 16.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this morning to a crest of 17.2 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage by early this evening.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/abr.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 830 PM CDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 31 at 8:04AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 39.2 feet
just after midnight tonight.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.
